title: BEYOND YOUR
OWN REACH
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: soft sunlight streaming through a window
dust motes dancing in midday sun
open leather journal on a wooden desk
golden light hitting a white wall

scenes.a: The heavy weight of that situation you are currently facing is bending your spirit today.
Bring your limited perspective before the creator who sustains the very breath in your lungs.
But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
Lord, quiet the anxious striving that fills my afternoon and help me to trust You.
Remove the barriers I have built with my own hands and replace them with faith.
Grant me the peace to wait upon Your perfect will as the sun peaks high.
